name: HCS Feature Selection Benchmark
description: Evaluates feature selection methods for compressing image-derived information in high-content screening, assessing how well compression preserves downstream analysis and predictive performance.
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used within the bioimaging/high-content screening community with limited broader adoption.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark; sensitive to batch effects, imaging artifacts, and experimental variability; dataset sizes may be moderate or small and results depend heavily on downstream task and classifier choice.
